caption: Fig. 1. X01 horizon mechanism: earlier installation can reduce the time needed to serve C3 from 8 s to 4 s, provided all lifecycle constraints hold.

referenceChanges.before: The remaining family settings are shown in Fig. 1. At 100 bytes per frame and 400 bytes per second, each frame lasts 0.25 seconds; the two directional thresholds of 400 bytes require eight frames, or two seconds. A pre-active installed pair therefore needs SWITCH+OPEN+payload, four seconds, while a prepared pair needs INSTALL+SWITCH+OPEN+payload, eight seconds. An already active pair needs REUSE+payload, three seconds. These are necessary timing totals for those chains, not universal sufficient conditions: resource use, whole frames, deadlines, and strict completion of management before contact loss are checked by execution.
